claim: MYR to EUR exchange rate verified June 2026 at roughly 0.217.
quote: As of June 2, 2026, 1 Malaysian Ringgit equals 0.2169 Euros.

claim: Best dry/low-humidity window Jan-Mar; Apr/May and Oct are good shoulder months; avoid Chinese New Year crowds.
quote: The best time to visit Melaka is during the dry season, from January to March... Chinese New Year often falls in February, which brings vibrant celebrations but also higher crowds and prices.

claim: Malaysia has shifting monsoon seasons that affect best travel timing.
quote: When is the best time to visit Malaysia?

claim: Melaka sits ~2 degrees north of equator (~31C day, ~24C night, ~70% humidity) and is oddly spared the Oct-Nov peninsular rains.
quote: the historic port of Melaka is weirdly spared during the period when rains pick up on the peninsula from October to November... mercury hovers around 31C by day and slips only to 24C after dark... humidity is usually 70%.

claim: The Majestic Malacca is built around a restored 1920s Straits-Settlement mansion with original porcelain tile flooring and teakwood fittings, on Jalan Bunga Raya in the UNESCO zone.
quote: The restored 1920s Straits Settlement mansion, with its original porcelain tile flooring and teakwood fittings, forms the core of the property.

claim: The Majestic is a Small Luxury Hotels of the World member with an award-winning Spa Village rooted in Peranakan therapies.
quote: The Majestic Malacca, a Member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, is a 1920s colonial mansion in the heart of Malacca.

claim: Majestic guest reviews are positive; spa and Kristang cuisine are highlights.
quote: Guests can indulge in the Spa Village Malacca's unique therapies, based on Peranakan culture, and savor the beautifully crafted Kristang cuisine.

claim: Majestic rates advertised from about $85/night though realistic rates are higher.
quote: Rates from 85$/night are available according to one source.

claim: The Majestic has 54 rooms and suites with luxe marble bathrooms and modern amenities.
quote: The 54 rooms and suites are beautifully designed, with luxe marble bathrooms alongside modern amenities that include minibars and flat-screen TVs.

claim: 5 Heeren is a 10-room Peranakan museum-residence on Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock (Heeren Street), one of Melaka's finest heritage streets.
quote: a time capsule of Peranakan opulence and history... The property sits on Heeren Street (Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock), one of Melaka's finest and most intact heritage streets... ten rooms total.

claim: 5 Heeren reopened Dec 2016 after a seven-year refurbishment, was ranked #1 of Melaka hotels, and serves a celebrated courtyard breakfast.
quote: recently opened in December 2016 after seven years of refurbishment. It ranks #1 out of 188 hotels in Melaka... guests love the courtyard which makes the breakfast dining experience unique.

claim: Melaka charges a RM10/room/night tourist tax for foreigners plus a RM4/room/night heritage tax since Jan 2025.
quote: a tourist tax of RM 10 per room per night is applied to all foreign guests... effective from 1st January 2025, the Melaka State Government imposed a mandatory MYR 4.00 Heritage Tax Fee per occupied room per night.

claim: Hotel Puri is a restored Peranakan house on Heeren Street built 1822, once owned by descendants of philanthropist Tan Kim Seng, with a peaceful courtyard.
quote: a carefully restored Peranakan house which once belonged to the descendants of an eminent philanthropist and rubber plantation owner, Tan Kim Seng... on Melaka's heritage Heeren Street, originally built in 1822.

claim: Hotel Puri rates start from about $48/night.
quote: Hotel Puri Melaka from $48.

claim: Courtyard Heeren is a spotless mansion that feels like a mini museum, with restaurants and museums nearby.
quote: The whole mansion is like a mini museum itself, and the place was spotless clean.

claim: Heeren House is a renovated 100-year-old building in Peranakan/colonial style at the start of Heeren Street, with river glimpses from most rooms.
quote: a renovated 100-year-old building furnished in traditional Peranakan and colonial style... every room offers at least a glimpse of the river and historical sights beyond.

claim: Heeren House carries approval from Lonely Planet, Frommer's and Afar Magazine.
quote: Heeren House comes in at 81 with approval from 4 reviews like Lonely Planet, Frommer's and Afar Magazine.

claim: 1825 Gallery Hotel combines three 1825-vintage shophouses, 5 min from the Jonker night market, with rates from about $37.
quote: Three 1825 vintage shophouses have been combined to create this classy boutique hotel... a 5-minute walk from Jonker Street Night Market.

claim: Liu Men occupies restored pre-war shophouses at 48-56 Jalan Tokong, blending art deco with Peranakan ambiance, with suites named for Sultanate figures.
quote: Art deco decor and design, heightened with Peranakan ambiance; each space embraces the unique history that is Melaka... 48-56 Jalan Tokong. Named suites include Parameswara, Cheng Ho, Kapitan, Jebat, and Hang Tuah.

claim: Liu Men offers L'Occitane amenities and free minibar snacks with strong personalised service but no pool or gym.
quote: L'Occitane bath products, free minibar snacks... while some mention the lack of a pool or gym, the overall cleanliness and charm make Liu Men Hotel a standout choice.

claim: Baba House features Peranakan-themed chambers and Nyonya cuisine at its Mari Chiak restaurant.
quote: featuring traditional Peranakan & Oasis designed chambers and authentic Nyonya cuisine proudly served at Mari Chiak Restaurant.

claim: Baba House has about 100 rooms 5 minutes from Jonker, with a rooftop bar (Kaki Minom) and reading-room library.
quote: Located just 5 minutes on foot from Jonker Street Night Market... 100 air-conditioned rooms... the Kaki Minom (Drinking Friends) rooftop bar, Bilek Bacha Library (Reading Room).

claim: Jonker Boutique Hotel is a 3-storey refurbished heritage building with a British colonial facade on Jonker Street.
quote: housed in a stylish 3-story refurbished heritage building along Jonker Street... an old-style British colonial building facade but with modern design combined with traditional Peranakan influences inside.

claim: Jonker Boutique Hotel rates from about MYR180.
quote: Jonker Boutique Hotel, Malacca, Malaysia. Rates from MYR180.

claim: Casa del Rio is a riverside 5-star on Jalan Kota Laksamana with a rooftop pool overlooking the Melaka River and Mediterranean-with-Chinese/Dutch/Arabic architecture.
quote: Panoramic views of the Malacca River unfold from the hotel's rooftop pool... Arabic, Chinese and Dutch influences woven into the dominantly Mediterranean architecture.

claim: Casa del Rio is ranked #6 of Melaka hotels, has 66 rooms of >=50 sqm, 2 min from Jonker Walk, with rates from about $127.
quote: ranked #6 of 193 hotels in Melaka... 66 guest rooms and suites, each covering a minimum of 50 sq meters... rates starting at $127.

claim: The Settlement is a 1960s administrative building reimagined as an art-led boutique near the Portuguese Settlement in Ujong Pasir, with a 350-year-old sultan bed, salvaged Sumatran mosque tiles, garden villas and a town shuttle.
quote: set in a four-story government building dating from the 1960s, with the front porch equipped with a handsome, 350-year-old sultan bed, and floor tiles sourced from a Sumatran mosque... Adjacent to the Portuguese Settlement... in Ujong Pasir.

claim: The Settlement Hotel rates from about MYR225.
quote: The Settlement Hotel, Malacca, Malaysia. Rates from MYR225.

claim: The Sterling has 37 rooms in a colonial-style building; signature rooms add a private sundeck and outdoor jacuzzi; rooftop breakfast with skyline views.
quote: 37 rooms and suites set in a colonial-style building... Signature rooms feature their own private sundeck and outdoor jacuzzi... breakfast room is located on the rooftop.

claim: The Sterling sits in a quiet locale two minutes from Little India, ~10-15 min walk to the old city, with no pool or spa.
quote: a quiet locale conveniently located within walking distance (10-15 mins) of the old city... just a two-minute walk from Little India... no pool, spa, or fitness center.

claim: Gingerflower is a restored Peranakan townhouse on Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock with three air-well courtyards, coloured wall mouldings, antique marble and a turn-of-the-century water well; its narrow-deep plan reflects Dutch frontage taxation.
quote: three air well courtyards... ornately decorated facades with vividly colored wall mouldings, and reconditioned antique marble... a preserved turn-of-the-century water well... the narrow, deep townhouse design reflects Dutch-era taxation methods based on street-front width.

claim: Gingerflower is reviewed as a quiet, design-forward heritage townhouse on Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock.
quote: Gingerflower Boutique Hotel - located at No. 13, Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock, 75200 Malacca.

claim: Imperial Heritage is a heritage-styled contemporary boutique hotel on Jalan Merdeka with rooms from MYR180 to MYR400+.
quote: Imperial Deluxe (from MYR180+)... Family Suites (from MYR400+)... on Jalan Merdeka in Melaka's city center.

claim: The Coco Journey is a coconut-grove farmstay at Klebang Besar with transparent Eco Domes (from RM588), Eco Tents (from RM388) and a 16-guest Villa (from RM1,988).
quote: Eco Dome @Coco... Price: from RM588/night. Eco Tent @Coco... from RM388/night. Villa @Coco... from RM1,988/night... nestled in a coconut grove in Melaka (Lot 276, Mukim Klebang Besar).

claim: Orchard Go-Daddy offers safari-style glamping within a 120-acre award-winning plantation resort with farm experiences and honey harvesting.
quote: Set within the award-winning 120-acre plantation of The Orchard Resort in Melaka... farm experiences, Harvesting Honey, and access to facilities.

claim: Beach N Breeze offers sea-view glamping units with AC, private bathrooms, shared kitchen and BBQ.
quote: Each unit features air-conditioning, a private bathroom, and sea views... shared kitchen, indoor and outdoor play areas, and barbecue facilities.

claim: Booking.com lists multiple glamping sites in Melaka.
quote: The 10 best glamping sites in Melaka, Malaysia | Booking.com

claim: CHCH is a three-storey heritage shophouse on Jalan Bukit Cina inside the UNESCO zone with a bakery cafe, private parking and a private first floor, 5-10 min walk to Jonker.
quote: a spacious three-storey heritage shophouse along Jalan Bukit Cina, within the UNESCO Heritage Zone... 5-10 minutes' walk to the Red House and Jonker Street, with full privacy on the entire first floor.

claim: Opposite Place - West Suite is a restored pre-war double-storey shophouse on a narrow lane in old Chinatown.
quote: A restored pre-war double-storey shophouse hidden along a narrow street in Melaka's old Chinatown.

claim: Options/The Edge curates a roundup of beautiful boutique stays in Melaka.
quote: 8 beautiful hotels and boutique stays in Melaka for your next visit.

claim: The Jonker Street UNESCO area offers a variety of heritage accommodations near the night market.
quote: This UNESCO World Heritage Site in Melaka Offers a Variety of Accommodations For a Pleasant Holiday Stay.

claim: Eco Tree Hotel is an eco-themed central budget option in Malacca City.
quote: Eco Tree Hotel in Malacca City | 2026 Updated prices, deals.

claim: Heeren Straits Hotel is a restored shophouse on Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock (Heeren Street).
quote: theLOCATION | Heeren Straits Hotel [Official]
